frozen_phase2a.modification_policy: READ_ONLY; preserve classifications, FDR values, and eligibility exactly

clinical_confounding.categorical_effect_size: Cramer's V with V=sqrt(chi_square/n) for 2x2 tables
clinical_confounding.estimable: both groups contain every modeled categorical level with at least 2 patients per level, or continuous ranges overlap and both groups have at least 5 patients
clinical_confounding.weakly_estimable: some overlap exists but a categorical cell has fewer than 2 patients, a group has fewer than 5 patients, or continuous overlap is narrow
clinical_confounding.non_estimable: a categorical level has zero support in one disease group or continuous ranges do not overlap

program_score.method: centered within-sample rank score on TMM logCPM pseudobulk expression
program_score.inference: exact enumeration of disease labels conditional on observed group sizes
program_score.multiplicity: BH within the frozen 20-program universe separately for each sensitivity and contrast

restricted_sensitivities.iugr: retain the Phase 2A eligible patients, then remove IUGR-positive PE patients; require at least 3 retained patients per group
restricted_sensitivities.delivery: LOPE C-section-only; require at least 3 retained patients per group; EOPE is NON_ESTIMABLE when no C-section early controls exist
restricted_sensitivities.induction: audit positivity only; do not adjust or subset when a disease group lacks one induction level

yang_replication.annotation_reconstruction: outcome-blind canonical-marker maximum score; minimum two detected marker genes and score margin >=0.05
yang_replication.cell_qc: published thresholds: UMI >2000, UMI <150000, mitochondrial fraction <25%; DGE files are already filtered but rules are rechecked

MC.reason: published MC does not distinguish fetal Hofbauer from other macrophage/DC states

yang_replication.test_universe: only the 20 frozen Admati SHARED_PE programs

cameraPR_statistic.formula: signed(abs(mean(set-member signed edgeR QL statistics) / sd(all estimable gene statistics))) with sign forced to cameraPR Direction

redundancy.scope: within cell type and frozen direction
redundancy.module_rule: connected components including singleton nodes; biological labels assigned only after inspecting component membership
